newsitem.title: HONG KONG: BOS Australia signs Euro-Debt Programme.
newsitem.headline: BOS Australia signs Euro-Debt Programme.

text.p: BOS International (Australia) has signed a US$500 million Euro-Debt Issuance Programme, arranger Westpac Banking Corp said on Monday.
Westpac said the programme will allow BOSA to diversify its funding sources and to issue both Euro-commercial paper and medium-term notes under one programme.
Westpac said the notes were guaranteed by the Governor and Company of the Bank of Scotland.
In addition to Westpac Banking Corp, dealers for the programme are BA Asia, Commonwealth Bank of Australia and BT Asia.
Westpac Banking Corp Hong Kong branch is the facility and issuing and paying agent.
